verdict.rationale: Docs show several forms of mid-task interaction—jumping into the Interactive Browser (devin-docs-7), taking over in Devin's IDE after a first draft (devin-docs-5), watching/copying terminal output (devin-docs-6), and tagging Devin in ongoing Slack/Teams threads (devin-docs-4)—implying a developer can intervene in an active session, but there is no explicit documentation of sending a follow-up chat message to steer an already-running agent session without restarting it, nor any independent hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs on message-based mid-session steering, confirmation that follow-ups don't reset/restart the task, and independent verification of the feature working in practice.
